lines.rom: om jaya parasudhari svami jaya parasudhari sura nara munijana sevata sripati avatari
jamadagni suta nara simha mam renuka jaya martanda bhrgu vamsaja tribhuvana yasa chaya
kamdhe sutra janeu gala rudraksa mala carana kharaum sobhe tilaka tripunda bhala
tamra syama ghana kesa sisa jata bamdhi sujana hetu rtu madhumaya dusta dalana amdhi
